title: 第1370章 是你儿子第1369章 本仙王看好你
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
擂台后方的光门灵光再度闪动，第二组参赛天骄应声登台。
台下观者热议再起：
“此番我看好西域熊罡！天生蛮力盖世，号称西域大力士。
一拳可崩山裂石，真正一力破万法！”
“未必！魔域小魔女的神通最为诡异，变幻莫测，胜负还真不好说！”
“熊罡加油！”
“小魔女，速战速决！”
众人目光聚焦台上的对决双方，各自给喜欢的天骄加油。
人群之中，夺天淡淡扫了擂台一眼，又转头看向身侧的落尘：
“小师弟，你定下的这套规矩，颇有深意，格局很大，不妨继续说下去。”
落尘点点头，继续道：
“二师兄，你素来知晓，我的大道核心便是齐同慈爱，众生平等。
可纵观诸天无尽岁月，真正的平等，从来最难践行。”
“世人自降生那一刻起，便注定难以全然均等。
天资优劣、根骨高低、容貌禀赋，皆是与生俱来的差距。
而最难以逾越的鸿沟，从来不是天赋，而是出身。”
“权贵子嗣、世家子弟，生来便坐拥无尽资源、无上机缘；
可寻常修士、布衣百姓的后代，纵有绝世天赋，也往往受制于资源匮乏。难得机缘，最终埋没庸尘。”
“世人常说龙生龙、凤生凤，此言虽有天道常理，却绝非定数。
天玄亿万生灵，藏龙卧虎，身负逆天资质的寒门子弟数不胜数。

他们缺的从不是天赋与勤勉，只是缺少登顶的机缘与资源。”
“如今天玄涅盘新生，稳步晋升神域，世间妖孽天骄只会越来越多。
我执掌这片天地，便想尽我所能，抹平出身之差。
天玄要善待每一个有上进心的后辈。”
“故而我立下铁规：自我开始，霸天城所有中高层子嗣，一律禁止特殊化。”
“我要尽最大可能，在这片天地守住公道。
成全每一位有天赋、肯吃苦、愿修行的孩子。
不让寒门奇才被家世埋没，让努力的人皆有出路。
这亦是天玄长久兴盛、永续壮大的根本。”
“另一方面，那些依靠家世庇护的子嗣，唯有彻底剥离依仗、褪去庇护，独自历经磨砺，方能淬炼出最纯粹、最坚韧的道心。”
“待他们年满十八，道心初定，心性成型、自立自强之后，可告知其真实身世。
content_en:
The light gate at the back of the arena flashed again, and the second group of talented contestants took the stage.
The audience in the audience started to discuss heatedly:
"This time I am optimistic about Xiong Gang from the Western Regions! He is born with unparalleled brute strength and is known as the strongman of the Western Regions.
One punch can break mountains and crack rocks, truly defeating all methods with one punch! "
"Not necessarily! The little witch in the Demon Realm has the weirdest magical powers. She is unpredictable. It's hard to say whether she will win or lose!"
"Come on Xiong Gang!"
"Little witch, fight quickly!"
Everyone's eyes were focused on the two sides on the stage, each cheering for their favorite talent.
Among the crowd, Duotian glanced at the ring briefly, then turned to look at Luochen beside him:
"Junior brother, this set of rules you have set is quite meaningful and has a big pattern. You might as well continue."
Luochen nodded and continued:
"Second Senior Brother, you have always known that the core of my Dao is universal love and equality for all living beings.
But throughout the endless ages of the universe, true equality has always been the most difficult to practice. "
“From the moment everyone is born, they are destined not to be completely equal.
Talent, strength, appearance, and endowment are all innate differences.
The most difficult gap to bridge is never talent, but background. "
“Heirs of powerful people and noble families are born with endless resources and unparalleled opportunities;
But the descendants of ordinary monks and ordinary people, even if they have extraordinary talents, are often limited by lack of resources. A rare opportunity, finally buried in mediocrity. "
"People often say that dragons give birth to dragons, and phoenixes give birth to phoenixes. Although this statement is a common sense of heaven, it is by no means a given.
There are billions of creatures in Tianxuan, hidden dragons and crouching tigers, and there are countless children from poor families with unparalleled qualifications.
What they lack is never talent or diligence, but the opportunity and resources to reach the top. "
“Now that Tianxuan is reborn from Nirvana and is steadily promoted to the divine realm, there will only be more and more evil and talented people in the world.
I am in charge of this world, so I want to do my best to smooth out the difference in origin.
Tianxuan should be kind to every junior who is motivated. "
"Therefore, I have set an iron rule: starting from now on, all mid-level and high-level descendants of Tyrant City are prohibited from becoming special."
“I will do my best to uphold justice in this world.
To help every child who is talented, willing to endure hardship and willing to practice.
Don't let talented people from poor families be buried by their family background, and let everyone who works hard have a way out.
This is also the foundation for Tianxuan's long-term prosperity and sustainable growth. "
"On the other hand, those heirs who rely on the protection of their family background can only temper their purest and most tenacious Taoist hearts by completely stripping away their reliance and protection, and going through hardships alone."
“When they reach the age of eighteen, their Taoist mind has been initially determined, their character has been formed, and they are self-reliant and self-reliant, we can tell them their true life experience.
